fields.title: 2. Company disclosures — risks already on record
fields.md:
| Item | 10-Q (2026-10-22) Note 16 original text | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Virginia notice | Notice of violation of Va. Code § 59.1-203 on 2026-10-19 (SpaceX·SpaceXAI·X Corp.) — 'contemplating bringing suit' | [10-Q R25](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R25.htm) |
| Same type of suits | Class action (N.D. Cal.) and individual suit (W.D. Ark.) related to Grok image generation and editing features · Baltimore city suit (2026-03-24, the company was dropped through voluntary withdrawal) | Same as above |
| Loss assessment | 'not currently able to estimate the reasonably possible loss or range of loss' | Same as above |
| Litigation provision | $350M (2026-09-30) · $399M (2025-12-31) — no allocation by case | Same as above |
| Oregon | No mention — a new party after the 10-Q | Same as above |

- **Reading**: The Virginia matter came in the order of notice (10/19), disclosure (10/22), and suit (11/23). The Oregon matter involves a new party, but the allegations and type of claim are the same. Whether the two will go the way of the Baltimore matter, with defendants dropped or removal to federal court, is judged only from court records (source: 10-Q R25 · `state.triggers_next_12m[T18]`).
